summary: Iteration 60 - Multi-Tenant Client Portal V2 Testing Complete. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - Login, Dashboard, Tickets (with creation), Devices, Invoices, Backups, Compliance, QBR, Settings, 2FA Setup, and Logout all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Portal V2 is a well-implemented self-contained SPA at /portal-app with separate auth context
All portal endpoints properly scope data to client_id (Acme Corporation = client-001)
2FA implementation uses pyotp for TOTP - QR code generated via external QR service
Ticket creation correctly sets source='client_portal' for tracking
Dark zinc theme (bg-zinc-950) provides good contrast and professional appearance
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Sidebar shows NexusOps branding with client name below
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed tickets during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal V2 fully tested. All 8 portal pages working: Dashboard (stats cards), Tickets (list + create), Devices (table with CPU/RAM/Disk/Status), Invoices (list), Backups (summary + jobs), Compliance (4 frameworks with progress), QBR (empty state shown - no QBR data for client), Settings (profile + 2FA setup). 2FA setup shows QR code and manual key. Logout returns to login page. Backend uses MOCKED/SEEDED data for compliance frameworks and backup jobs.

portal_login.details: Login with john@acmecorp.com/portal123 works, returns token and user object

portal_dashboard.details: Shows 15 open tickets, 7/10 devices online, $0 outstanding, 2 resolved. Quick links to Backups, Compliance, QBR

portal_tickets.details: Shows 17+ tickets for Acme Corp. New Ticket button opens dialog with Subject, Description, Category, Priority. Ticket creation works with success toast

portal_ticket_creation.details: Created ticket appears in list with source=client_portal, status=open

portal_devices.details: Shows 10 devices with status summary (7 online, 0 warning, 3 offline). Table shows Device, Type, OS, CPU, RAM, Disk, Status columns

portal_invoices.details: Shows 2 invoices (INV-1002, INV-1003) with Draft status and amounts ($1,199, $1,100)

portal_backups.details: Shows 66.7% success rate, 4 successful, 0 failed, 6 total jobs. Job table with status badges

portal_compliance.details: Shows 4 frameworks: NIST 800-171 (77%), CIS Controls v8 (74%), SOC 2 Type II (78%), HIPAA (79%) with progress bars

portal_qbr.details: Shows empty state 'No QBR reports available yet' - expected as no QBR data for this client

portal_settings.details: Shows Profile card (John Smith, john@acmecorp.com, Acme Corporation, Admin role) and 2FA section

portal_2fa_setup.details: Clicking 'Set Up 2FA' shows QR code, manual key (32 chars), code input, and Enable 2FA button

portal_logout.details: Sign Out button returns to login page, clears localStorage tokens

backend_api_login.details: POST /api/portal/v2/login returns token for valid credentials, 401 for invalid

backend_api_tickets.details: GET returns client tickets, POST creates ticket with source=client_portal

backend_api_me.details: GET /api/portal/v2/me returns user profile with client and branding info

backend_api_2fa.details: GET /api/portal/v2/setup-2fa returns TOTP secret and provisioning URI

mocked_apis.note: Backend uses mock/seeded data for some features
